people.name: Jobab
people.line: A son of Shaharaim and Hodesh

people.name: Mesha
people.line: A descendant of Benjamin born in Moab.

translations.web: By Hodesh his wife, he became the father of Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,
translations.bsb: His sons by his wife Hodesh: Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,
translations.kjv: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,
translations.asv: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcam,
